evidence: 10ms grid and T100 window with exact int64 timestamps and warming_up padding
acquisition AND availability deadlines; inclusive age cap; observed/held/unavailable masks
late observations may enter later slots but never rewrite committed slots
future acquisition and future reset cannot change prior committed output
batch and streaming trace equivalence including regressed recorded availability
RX/TX reset, excluded/uncertain boundaries and clock segments invalidate appropriate links
old segment/clock/epoch cannot revive before recovery; recovery delta remains invalid
held delta zero/invalid; long acquisition gap severs feature history
immutable feature, slot and window arrays; bounded T-slot retention
all-current-links missing yields insufficient_coverage, never an empty-room claim
fractional millisecond config converts to exact integer nanoseconds; sub-ns config rejected
feature_validation: Explicit fixture copies I and computes an unscaled difference; not the S07 log-amplitude/delta formula.
not_implemented_or_measured: S07 feature formula and train-only normalization
runtime build/replay/live CLI and scheduled pose outputs
grid telemetry provider and live backpressure
hardware timing accuracy, inference accuracy or latency
